build_BetaBernoulliBasicModel: build a BetaBernoulliBasicModel with alpha and beta tensors for conjugate Beta-Bernoulli inference
create_gen_obs: create observations by calling gen_obs on BetaBernoulliBasicModel with a specified number of samples
test_BetaBernoulliOpsModel_sum_y: test the sum_y functional method on BetaBernoulliOpsModel to aggregate Bernoulli random variables
review_BetaBernoulliScaleHyperParameters: review the theta random variable in BetaBernoulliScaleHyperParameters that scales alpha and beta hyperparameters
